name: sandbox-tools
description: The consumer of the sandbox@1 seam: `sandbox check` (the raw decision for one request plus the active policy), `sandbox policy` (active policy + the provider's measured enforcement matrix) and `sandbox run` (run a command through an ENFORCING provider). Publishes only tool surfaces; the policy itself comes from a core provider plugin.

config.description: How verbose the decision answers are.

reportPolicy.description: Include the active policy in every `sandbox check` answer.
